title: Characterization Morphology of Palo Azul (Eysenhardtia polystachya) by Scanning Electron Microscopy
content: Currently, Mexico and various regions worldwide have reported a rise in kidney damage cases, a common complication among patients with chronic degenerative diseases such as diabetes mellitus and hypertension. In response to this growing issue, there is a pressing need to explore natural alternatives that can help mitigate or manage kidney damage. One such promising option is Palo Azul (Eysenhardtia polystachya), a plant known for its antioxidant, antidiuretic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may offer therapeutic benefits for kidney health [1].
